title: Practice 11: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **зайдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**зайдёшь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
exercises.prompt: Won't you come over to my place?

exercises.why: **зайдёшь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
exercises.prompt: Won't you come in for a moment?

exercises.why: **заходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of заходить: imperfective (perfective partner: зайти).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**залезаем** — present tense (1st person plural) of залезать: imperfective (perfective partner: залезть).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**заходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of заходить: imperfective (perfective partner: зайти).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
exercises.prompt: Come in. The door is open.

exercises.why: **зайдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst). Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.
exercises.prompt: Let's stop by the post office.

exercises.why: **зайдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst). Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.
